comment: Exercises the Phase-1 story systems before the chapter that uses them exists: a scene that grants evidence + a knot + guild standing (notice card), a Remembered Day flashback, a favor-knot redemption beat, and a standing-gated scene that only appears because the Chandlers are annoyed. Uses this spec's OWN scenes via the `story` key.

story.art_desc: the Shambles, mid-morning, everything for sale
lines: Three systems, one page each. Watch what the night hands you.
A thing for the board. A knot in your thread. A guild taking notes.

story.title: The Ninth Stray
story.art_desc: the warm parlor, years ago, snow at the window
lines: She counted strays that winter and got to eight before the eighth bit her.
'Nine, then,' she said, to nobody, in the snow.
The ninth did not bite. The ninth was thinking about it.
A Chandlers' lamp gutters as Ash passes. Coincidence, obviously.
This page only exists because a guild is annoyed with you.
